.github/workflows/deterministic-manufact.text:
# [B16-A F9] The deterministic prompt-to-Gerber manufacturing path runs in CI on
# every pull request and on main: fake provider adapter, committed KiCad
# fixtures, committed router recordings replayed by placed-board revision (the
# bundled FreeRouting runtime is local-only), frozen clock, deterministic UUIDs,
# pinned release identities (archive sha256, release id, board revision).
# No credentials, no database, no network. A drift in ANY identity fails here.
#
# [B16-B] The `database-delivery` job proves the migration mechanism on a
# disposable in-process PostgreSQL (PGlite): clean / upgrade / replay / drift /
# interruption, executable RLS and CHECK behaviour, schema-first parity, and
# that every DB-backed test is opt-in (no marker → skipped, never failed).
name: deterministic-manufacturing

on:
  pull_request:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  prompt-to-gerber:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 25
    env:
      # The acceptance suite writes its evidence (ZIP, manifest, check tables) here — never under the repository.
      # (a literal path: the `runner` context is not available in job-level env)
      SIRKIT_B16_1C_EVIDENCE_DIR: /tmp/sirkit-b16-1c-evidence
    steps:
      - run: echo "SIRKIT_JOB_STARTED_AT=$(date +%s)" >> "$GITHUB_ENV" # [B24-D1] OD-30: prompt-to-gerber's start
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
        with:
          version: 11.2.2
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 24
          cache: pnpm
      - run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
      # [B19-E E2 CI] a full, non-incremental type check needs about 2.2 GB (measured locally: 2.12 GB at 2dee62c, 2.19 GB at
      # 5c8de9d), past Node's default heap on the runner, where tsc was killed out of memory. Resources only; no check changed.
      - run: pnpm exec tsc --noEmit
        env:
          NODE_OPTIONS: --max-old-space-size=4096
      # Narrow, deterministic suites only (never the whole suite here): the
      # acceptance + recovery pipelines, the manufacturing routes and their
      # hardening tests, the fabrication gate, the browser workflow panel, the
      # invariant tripwires and the locale-independence proof.
      - run: >-
          pnpm exec vitest run
          app/lib/workflow/prompt-to-gerber/__tests__

  # No database, no credits, no live router; live provider/auth variations stay

  page-browser-e2e:

      - name: Orchestration browser proof (B21 F2)

        run: pnpm exec tsx scripts/ci-job-headroom.ts .github/workflows/deterministic-manufacturing.yml page-browser-e2e

  # [B24-A1] D24-1 (offline), OD-190: production mode in CI - `next build`, then `next start`, then fail-closed probes. This is the
  # first `next build` in CI, and the first since B22 added engine-worker.mjs (B22 final-verdict.md:110): whether it is emitted is
  # printed, and named computations stay off. The server declares the ci profile, the expected origin and a worker secret generated
  # for this run (masked); no Supabase, database, provider or fixture variable is set, so sensitive routes refuse and readiness
  # answers 503. Nothing is deployed and no live resource is used: staging and production stay BLOCKED-LIVE-QUALIFICATION (LB-13).
  production-smoke:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 20
    env:
      SMOKE_PORT: "3200"
      SMOKE_ORIGIN: http://localhost:3200
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
        with:
          version: 11.2.2
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 24
          cache: pnpm
      - run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
      - name: next build (production)
        env:
          NODE_OPTIONS: --max-old-space-size=4096
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          started=$(date +%s)
          pnpm exec next build 2>&1 | tee next-build.log
          echo "next build took $(( $(date +%s) - started )) s"
          emitted="$(find .next -name 'engine-worker*' -print)"
          if [ -n "$emitted" ]; then echo "engine-worker.mjs: emitted"; echo "$emitted"; else echo "engine-worker.mjs: not emitted"; fi
      - name: next start (production, in the background)
        env:
          SIRKIT_DEPLOYMENT_ENV: ci
          SIRKIT_EXPECTED_ORIGIN: http://localhost:3200
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          secret="$(openssl rand -hex 32)"
          echo "::add-mask::${secret}"
          echo "SMOKE_WORKER_SECRET=${secret}" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
          started=$(date +%s)
          SIRKIT_WORKFLOW_WORKER_SECRET="${secret}" nohup pnpm exec next start --port "$SMOKE_PORT" > next-start.log 2>&1 &
          echo $! > next-start.pid
          for attempt in $(seq 1 90); do
            if curl -fsS -o /dev/null "$SMOKE_ORIGIN/api/health"; then echo "next start answered after $(( $(date +%s) - started )) s"; exit 0; fi
            sleep 1
          done
          echo "next start did not answer /api/health within 90 s"
          exit 1
      - name: Probe the production server (fail-closed answers)
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          status() { curl -s -o "$1" -w '%{http_code}' "${@:2}"; }
          test "$(status health.json "$SMOKE_ORIGIN/api/health")" = 200
          grep -qF '{"ok":true}' health.json
          test "$(status ready.json -H "Authorization: Bearer ${SMOKE_WORKER_SECRET}" "$SMOKE_ORIGIN/api/ready")" = 503
          grep -qF '{"name":"deployment_profile","state":"not_serving"}' ready.json
          grep -qF '{"name":"supabase_auth_configuration","state":"not_configured"}' ready.json
          grep -qF '{"name":"database","state":"not_configured"}' ready.json
          if grep -qF "${SMOKE_WORKER_SECRET}" ready.json; then echo "the readiness answer carries the worker secret"; exit 1; fi
          test "$(status ready-anonymous.json "$SMOKE_ORIGIN/api/ready")" = 401
          test "$(status autonomy.json -H 'x-sirkit-project-id: smoke-project' "$SMOKE_ORIGIN/api/agent/autonomy")" = 403
          grep -qF '"code":"AUTH_PRODUCTION_NOT_CONFIGURED"' autonomy.json
          test "$(status signout-cross.json -X POST -H 'Origin: http://evil.example' "$SMOKE_ORIGIN/api/auth/signout")" = 403
          grep -qF '"code":"AUTH_CROSS_ORIGIN_DENIED"' signout-cross.json
          test "$(status signout.json -X POST -H "Origin: $SMOKE_ORIGIN" "$SMOKE_ORIGIN/api/auth/signout")" = 503
          grep -qF '"code":"AUTH_SIGNOUT_UNAVAILABLE"' signout.json
          test "$(curl -s -D ai-runtime.headers -o ai-runtime.json -w '%{http_code}' "$SMOKE_ORIGIN/api/ai/runtime")" = 200
          grep -qi '^content-security-policy:' ai-runtime.headers
          # [B24-A2] D24-5, OD-196: every security header with its exact value, and no X-Powered-By, on the page, an API route, the
          # liveness route and a file outside the proxy's matcher; no HSTS (this build had no SIRKIT_EXPECTED_ORIGIN: not https)
          for path in / /api/ai/runtime /api/health /favicon.ico; do
            curl -s -o /dev/null -D headers.txt "$SMOKE_ORIGIN$path"
            tr -d '\r' < headers.txt | sed -E 's/^([A-Za-z-]+):/\L\1:/' > headers.lf
            for expected in "content-security-policy: img-src 'self' data: blob:; frame-ancestors 'none'" "x-frame-options: DENY" "x-content-type-options: nosniff" "referrer-policy: strict-origin-when-cross-origin" "permissions-policy: camera=(), microphone=(), geolocation=(), payment=(), usb=()" "content-security-policy-report-only: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; connect-src 'self'; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'self'"; do
              grep -qxF "$expected" headers.lf || { echo "$path: a security header is missing or different: ${expected%%:*}"; exit 1; }
            done
            if grep -qi '^x-powered-by:' headers.lf; then echo "$path sends x-powered-by"; exit 1; fi
            if grep -qi '^strict-transport-security:' headers.lf; then echo "$path sends strict-transport-security on an http origin"; exit 1; fi
          done
          echo "every probe answered as pinned"
      - name: Stop the production server
        if: always()
        run: |
          if [ -f next-start.pid ]; then kill "$(cat next-start.pid)" 2>/dev/null || true; fi
          pkill -f "next start --port" 2>/dev/null || true
      - name: Upload the production-smoke logs
        if: failure()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: production-smoke-logs
          path: |
            next-build.log
            next-start.log
          if-no-files-found: ignore
          retention-days: 14

  # [B24-A2] D24-4, OD-195, runbook :168: the secret scan in tree mode - the closed rules and the reviewed allowlist of
  # app/lib/deployment/secret-scan.ts over every listed file - and, on a pull request, over every commit of it ([B24-A2 review]
  # security-3); a hit prints path:line rule only, never the text. Read-only git calls, no write; the workflow's read-only token.
  secret-scan:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10
    steps:

        with:

      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4

        with:

      - run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile

      - name: Scan every commit of the pull request (a secret added, then deleted, stays in the history a merge keeps)

          app/lib/distributors/__tests__/b19-connector-policy.test.ts
          app/lib/distributors/__tests__/b19-d-exact-mpn-connectors.test.ts
          app/components/parts/__tests__/b19-e-atomic-publication-panel.test.tsx
          app/lib/computation/__tests__
          app/lib/engineering/__tests__/b18-e-lost-settlement.test.ts
          app/lib/engineering/__tests__/b18-c-result-contract.test.ts

  # [B24-D4] OD-30: page-browser-e2e came within five minutes of its limit at B24-D3's run (27 min 40 s of 30, headroom 2 min 20 s),

.github/workflows/benchmark.yml.text:
name: benchmark-quality

on:
  pull_request:
  workflow_dispatch:
  schedule:
    - cron: "23 4 * * *"

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  benchmark-core:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 20
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
        with:
          version: 11.2.2
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 24
          cache: pnpm
      - run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
      # Output redirection captures the diagnostics for the failure artifact
      # WITHOUT masking the exit code (no pipes, no continue-on-error).
      - run: pnpm run benchmark:validate > benchmark-validate.json
      # [B19-E E2 CI] a full, non-incremental type check needs about 2.2 GB (measured locally: 2.12 GB at 2dee62c, 2.19 GB at
      # 5c8de9d), past Node's default heap on the runner, where tsc was killed out of memory. Resources only; no check changed.
      - run: pnpm exec tsc --noEmit
        env:
          NODE_OPTIONS: --max-old-space-size=4096
      - run: pnpm exec vitest run app/lib/benchmark/__tests__/stage-09-benchmark-core.test.ts --reporter=dot --reporter=junit --outputFile=vitest-benchmark-core.xml
      - run: pnpm run stage10:test -- --reporter=dot --reporter=junit --outputFile=vitest-stage10.xml
      - name: Upload failure diagnostics
        if: failure()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: benchmark-core-failure-diagnostics
          path: |
            benchmark-validate.json
            vitest-*.xml
          if-no-files-found: ignore
          retention-days: 14

  benchmark-nightly:
    if: github.event_name == 'schedule' || github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 90
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
        with:
          version: 11.2.2
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 24
          cache: pnpm
      - run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
      - run: pnpm run benchmark:validate > benchmark-validate.json
      # [B24-B2] D24-15, OD-204: the stage-09 corpus (every package outside the hidden holdout, below) runs only here, on schedule and
      # dispatch, through b24-b2-corpus-nightly and this step's flag; every pull-request job skips that suite's corpus cases.
      - run: pnpm exec vitest run app/lib/benchmark/__tests__/stage-09-benchmark-core.test.ts app/lib/pcb/__tests__/stage-08-professional-routing.test.ts app/lib/qualification/__tests__/b24-b2-corpus-nightly.test.ts --reporter=dot --reporter=junit --outputFile=vitest-nightly.xml
        env:
          SIRKIT_B24_CORPUS_NIGHTLY: "1"
      - run: pnpm run stage10:test -- --reporter=dot --reporter=junit --outputFile=vitest-stage10.xml
        if: ${{ !cancelled() }} # [B24-B2 review, 2026-10-08] a red corpus run above never skips this step
      - name: Upload failure diagnostics
        if: failure()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: benchmark-nightly-failure-diagnostics
          path: |
            benchmark-validate.json
            vitest-*.xml
          if-no-files-found: ignore
          retention-days: 14
      - name: Declare unavailable protected suites
        if: ${{ !cancelled() }} # [B24-B2 review, 2026-10-08] the holdout stays declared when a step above fails
        run: |
          echo "Hidden holdout requires holdout-admin credentials and is not exposed to CI candidates."
          echo "Licensed competitor runs require approved tools/operators and remain manual."

  # [B24-D1] D24-27, D24-28, OD-212: the latency benchmark - the four runbook measurement families (view/read commands, a granted
  # reversible edit, one verified workflow on recordings, the first stream event) and the moved performance bounds, each a
  # correctness-checked workload with fixed warm-ups and samples on this runner, gated only on regression against the recorded
  # baseline (artifacts/ai-control-plane-b24/latency-baseline.json). While its latest version is the declared-without-values v1,
  # baseline_missing is written BLOCKED (OD-212/OD-30: the owner has not accepted this job's minutes) and does not fail the gate (lead
  # decision D3); unmeasured, sample_shortfall and a regression always do. Every trigger of the workflow runs it (no if:). The results
  # go outside the repository; route-bench runs unchanged as its own step (its two absolute budgets stay, OD-234's question). The
  # gate, route-bench and headroom steps each run after an earlier red step and fail on their own; nothing is retried.
  # [B24-D2] D24-29, OD-212's memory half: b24-d2-memory rides the same vitest step and flag. --expose-gc goes to this step's workers
  # only, named twice on purpose: vitest's CLI hands ONE value to the forks pool as a string, which it spreads into characters (the
  # worker hangs; measured locally 2026-10-09), and two make the array the pool expects. No vitest.config.ts change.
  benchmark-latency:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30
    env:
      # outside the repository, as prompt-to-gerber's SIRKIT_B16_1C_EVIDENCE_DIR is (a literal path: the `runner` context is not available in job-level env)
      SIRKIT_B24_BENCHMARK_DIR: /tmp/sirkit-b24-benchmark
    steps:
      - run: mkdir -p "$SIRKIT_B24_BENCHMARK_DIR" && echo "SIRKIT_JOB_STARTED_AT=$(date +%s)" >> "$GITHUB_ENV" # [B24-D1] OD-30: benchmark-latency's start
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
        with:
          version: 11.2.2
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 24
          cache: pnpm
      - run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
      - run: pnpm exec vitest run app/lib/qualification/__tests__/b24-d1-latency.test.ts app/lib/qualification/__tests__/b24-d1-latency-workflow.test.ts app/lib/qualification/__tests__/b24-d2-memory.test.ts --no-file-parallelism --poolOptions.forks.execArgv=--expose-gc --poolOptions.forks.execArgv=--expose-gc --reporter=dot --reporter=junit --outputFile=vitest-benchmark-latency.xml
        env:
          SIRKIT_B24_BENCHMARK: "1"
      - if: success() || failure()
        run: pnpm exec tsx scripts/b24-latency-gate.ts
      - if: success() || failure()
        run: pnpm exec tsx scripts/route-bench.ts > "$SIRKIT_B24_BENCHMARK_DIR/route-bench.json"
      - if: success() || failure() # [B24-D1] OD-30: benchmark-latency's headroom (reports only)
        run: pnpm exec tsx scripts/ci-job-headroom.ts .github/workflows/benchmark.yml benchmark-latency --report-only
      - name: Upload the latency results
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: benchmark-latency-results
          path: |
            vitest-benchmark-latency.xml
            /tmp/sirkit-b24-benchmark
          if-no-files-found: ignore
          retention-days: 14
